message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jq && sed -n '737,756p' src/jv.c && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/jv_parse.c","function":"jv_parse_sized_custom_flags","line":862,"var":"string","code":"jv_parse_sized_custom_flags(const char* string, int length, int flags)","note":"Attacker-controlled JSON text enters jq through the parser entry point."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/jv_parse.c","function":"jv_parser_next","line":765,"var":"p->next","code":"jv value = jv_parser_next(&parser);","note":"The parser converts the text into a jv value; numeric literals are preserved as literal-number objects."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/jv.c","function":"jvp_literal_number_new","line":577,"var":"literal","code":"decNumberFromString(&n->num_decimal, literal, ctx);","note":"A numeric token is parsed into a decNumber payload, including NaN encodings when present."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/builtin.c","function":"f_sort_by_impl","line":800,"var":"keys","code":"return jv_sort(input, keys);","note":"sort_by forwards the parsed array and its computed keys into the sorting helper."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/jv_aux.c","function":"sort_cmp","line":663,"var":"a->key / b->key","code":"int r = jv_cmp(jv_copy(a->key), jv_copy(b->key));","note":"qsort repeatedly compares key values while ordering the array."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/jv.c","function":"jvp_number_cmp","line":742,"var":"literal numbers","code":"decNumberCompareTotal(&res, jvp_dec_number_ptr(a), jvp_dec_number_ptr(b), DEC_CONTEXT());","note":"The vulnerable comparison path uses total ordering on literal numbers, which reaches the decNumber compare logic on NaN operands."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/decNumber/decNumber.c","function":"decCompareOp","line":6048,"var":"merged","code":"if (merged) { ... decNaNs(res, lhs, rhs, set, status); }","note":"When either operand is NaN, the compare helper dispatches to decNaNs to materialize the comparison result."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/decNumber/decNumber.c","function":"decNaNs","line":7704,"var":"res->lsu / res->digits","code":"if (lhs->digits<=set->digits) decNumberCopy(res, lhs); else { ... for (ur=res->lsu, ul=lhs->lsu; ur<uresp1; ur++, ul++) *ur=*ul; }","note":"decNaNs copies the NaN payload into the caller-provided decNumber result buffer and can write past the stack buffer when the payload is too large, causing the ASAN stack-buffer-overflow."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/jq/src/jv.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true` executed with exit code 0.
